shows: last supported interaction + age or unknown
canonical message list/preview only when retained
rules: terminal SR/RFC frozen summary has no body navigation
MSG drafts never enter sent counts
coverage warning remains visible even when counts are nonzero

communications_workspace.message_list: keyboard/list contract from LLD10; one canonical row; purged rows visibly content-unavailable
communications_workspace.proposal_queue: contract/version,target,reason/evidence summary and accept-link/reject/defer actions; owning-domain fact acceptance navigates/invokes owning workflow rather than direct LLD09 mutation
communications_workspace.jobs: phase + exact counters; percentage only if estimated_total known
communications_workspace.housekeeping: orphan reason,due chronology,retention state and protected dependency status without exposing purged content

settings.processing: enabled, interval whole minutes, overlap messages, last/next run and Check now
settings.orphan_grace: positive duration with default seven exact days and explanation that existing pending due times are not silently rewritten
settings.sources: read-only PST/OST location, path-independent scope identity, folder roles and health

deep_scan.confirmation: always deliberate-action flow; progress visible; cancel safe
deep_scan.forbidden: no implicit Deep Scan from startup/import/failure/configuration

msg_draft.state: recipient/template/content preview -> choose local destination -> Generate
msg_draft.result: Generated/Exported clearly labelled draft; never Sent

accessibility: all direction/coverage/retention/job states have text/non-color cues
focus/keyboard/scroll ownership follows LLD10 shared interaction contracts
unknown chronology/coverage is spoken as unknown, never zero/complete
large bodies/attachments stay inside bounded preview/download surfaces
responsive: workbench operational and communication panes reflow without losing counts,warnings,selection,proposal state or draft context; narrow view uses explicit panel switch preserving state
